commits.message:
feat: implement shared budget.toml schema with validation (#102)

- Add LintsConfig struct with #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to reject
  unknown lint names at parse time, while BudgetConfig root leaves
  foreign top-level sections (network, source, functions.*) untouched
  for soroban-budget-assert coexistence
- Extract validate_lint_level() as pure Result-returning function for
  testability; validate severity as "allow"|"warn"|"deny"
- Replace silent if-let-Ok config parsing with unwrap_or_else that
  prints errors and exits
- Add 8 unit tests: valid lints, foreign section coexistence, unknown
  lint name rejection, empty/missing lints section, level validation
- Update test_fixtures/smoke_test/budget.toml to proper [lints] schema
  with soroban-budget-assert sections (network, source, functions.*)
- Document the full shared budget.toml schema and section ownership
  table in docs/integration.md

Closes #102
